description.value:
You surround your target with shimmering divine magic that coalesces into technological armor, building them a large, resilient shell. For the duration of the spell, the target stands taller, functions more reliably, and gains supernatural protection from harm. The target grows to Large size unless it's already Large or larger. Its equipment grows with it but returns to its usual size if removed. Its reach increases by 5 feet (or by 10 feet if it started out Tiny). The target also gains a +2 status bonus to AC and saving throws and 20 temporary Hit Points for the duration. The spell ends immediately when the target has no temporary Hit Points.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.Spell Effect: Divine Machine]

Heightened (+1) The temporary Hit Points granted by this spell increase by 5.
